bolumler.ozet: Section degil; body icindeki ilk top-level katman. position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:100vh;z-index:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform. Icinde sirasiyla 7 kardes div: (1) data-sahne="kor" radial-gradient(72% 96% at 50% 100%,rgba(183,53,28,.78),rgba(183,53,28,.2) 44%,transparent 70%), bottom:-14%, height:96%, animation:emberBreath 8s ease-in-out infinite, transition:opacity .9s ease-out,transform .9s ease-out; (2) data-sahne="cekirdek" left:50%;bottom:-10%;width:min(780px,110%);height:520px;translateX(-50%), radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(250,170,31,.42),transparent 72%), animation:emberSoft 11s ease-in-out infinite; (3) data-imlec="1" 620x620 daire, left:50%;top:62%;margin:-310px 0 0 -310px, radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(250,170,31,.16),transparent 74%), transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); (4-6) uc duman kuresi left:28%/52%/68%, 260/220/200px, blur(34px)/blur(30px)/blur(28px), animation:smokeDrift 22s/27s/32s linear infinite (gecikme 0/8s/16s); (7) inset vignette box-shadow:inset 0 0 260px rgba(0,0,0,.86); (8) 1px/3px repeating-linear-gradient grid overlay opacity:.5 rgba(242,233,220,.014). Tum sayfa boyunca scroll ile JS tarafindan translate3d ile yerinde kilitlenir.

position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:60;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(10,8,7,.9),rgba(10,8,7,0));transition:background .3s ease-out. Uc satir: (1) 2px yukseklikte ray rgba(242,233,220,.08) icinde data-ilerleme="1" 2px, width:0%, background:linear-gradient(to right,#B7351C,#FAAA1F), transition:width .12s linear; (2) data-gece-serit="1" display:none, padding:8px clamp(24px,5vw,64px), background:rgba(183,53,28,.2), gap:10px; icinde 7px nabiz noktasi (#FAAA1F, box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(250,170,31,.9), animation:dotPulse 2.4s) + 12.5px metin; (3) height:80px, padding:0 clamp(24px,5vw,64px), space-between. Sol: data-git="acilis" tiklanabilir logo = 6'li zar rayi (8/5/8/8/5/8px, gap:4px) + 'Ciğerci Bozo' 800 21px Bricolage Grotesque letter-spacing:-.03em. Sag: gap:30px ile Menü(link) / Gece(data-git) / Hikaye(link) / Konum(link) hepsi 500 15px Inter rgba(242,233,220,.86) transition:color .15s ease-out hover #FAAA1F; ardindan TR / EN dil ikilisi (600 14px, ayirici '/' rgba(242,233,220,.28)); en sagda kirmizi CTA.

position:fixed;right:26px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:55;flex-direction:column;align-items:center. Sirayla: 24px ust gradyan cizgi (linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,rgba(242,233,220,.28))), sonra 7 bead ve aralarinda 20px duz baglayici (2px genislik, rgba(242,233,220,.16)), sonda 24px alt gradyan cizgi (to top). Bead sirasi ve boyutu tavla zari motifini izler: acilis 14px(radius 2px), iddia 9px(radius 1px), ocaktan 14px, ikram 14px, gece 9px, bozo 14px, konum 14px. Pasif: background:rgba(242,233,220,.26); transition:all .3s ease-out. Her bead ayni zamanda data-git ile hedef bolume kaydirir.

section#acilis, min-height:100vh, flex-column, justify-content:center, padding:120px clamp(24px,5vw,64px) 0. Tek kolon, data-erit="1" sarmalayici max-width:1180px. Sira: (1) durum satiri flex-wrap gap:14px 26px margin-bottom:38px -> [nabiz rozeti: padding:10px 16px, background:rgba(10,8,7,.6), border:1px solid rgba(250,170,31,.3), 9px nokta + 'Şu an açığız' 600 14.5px #FAAA1F] + [buyuk saat: font:700 clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px)/1 Bricolage, tabular-nums, letter-spacing:-.015em, span data-saat-s + yanip sonen ':' (#FAAA1F, colonBlink 2s step-end) + span data-saat-d] + [data-durum-alt 400 14.5px rgba(242,233,220,.7)]; (2) H1 font:800 clamp(60px,10.4vw,168px)/1.06 Bricolage, letter-spacing:-.018em, text-shadow:0 8px 60px rgba(10,8,7,.6), iki satir
ile; (3) margin-top:28px alt-baslik satiri: 'meşe korunda' 800 clamp(34px,4.6vw,76px) rgba(242,233,220,.72) + yanina flex:1 min-width:260px zar rayi (20/12/20/20/12/20px, gap:12px) arkasinda 3px yatay cizgi linear-gradient(to right,#F2E9DC 54%,rgba(242,233,220,.1)); (4) margin-top:46px CTA satiri: primary buton (padding:20px 34px, 16.5px), outline buton 'Menüyü gör' (data-git="ocaktan", padding:19px 33px), ardindan meta metinler 'Girne, Naci Talat Caddesi' | 1px 14px ayirici | 'Her gün 10:00 - 05:00'; (5) margin-top:clamp(40px,6vh,72px) scroll ipucu (data-git="iddia"): 15px kare + 52px cizgi + 13px metin, transition:gap .2s ease-out, hover gap:22px.

section#iddia, min-height:100vh, align-items:center, padding:120px clamp(24px,5vw,64px). data-erit sarmalayici flex-wrap, gap:clamp(32px,4vw,72px). Iki kolon. SOL (flex:1 1 480px, min-width:0, padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px), background:rgba(10,8,7,.72), border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.1), backdrop-filter:blur(3px)): baslik 700 clamp(32px,4vw,54px)/1.12 Bricolage letter-spacing:-.02em; margin-top:22px paragraf 400 clamp(16px,1.35vw,19px)/1.65 rgba(242,233,220,.78) max-width:560px; margin-top:34px 3'lu sayac izgarasi (flex-wrap, gap:1px, background:rgba(242,233,220,.12) ile hairline ayirici; her hucre flex:1 1 150px, background:rgba(10,8,7,.9), padding:22px 24px, gap:9px) -> sayilar 700 clamp(44px,4.6vw,64px) Bricolage #FAAA1F tabular-nums, etiketler 400 14px/1.45 rgba(242,233,220,.74). Sayac degerleri: 8 (data-sayac="8"), 4+2 (statik, sayac yok), 3 (data-sayac="3"). SAG: foto plakasi (flex:1 1 360px, min-width:280px, max-width:520px, height:clamp(360px,54vh,560px), border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.22), box-shadow:inset 0 0 90px rgba(0,0,0,.5)); ortasinda opacity:.5 anahat zar rayi (22/13/22/22/13/22px, gap:11px, border 1px rgba(242,233,220,.5) ve rgba(250,170,31,.6)); dort kosede 24px L-koseleri 18px icerlek, 1px rgba(250,170,31,.6); sol-alt disinda tasan etiket kutusu (left:24px;bottom:-14px;padding:6px 12px;background:#0A0807) 18px cizgi + 12.5px metin.

section#ocaktan, min-height:100vh, align-items:center, padding:120px clamp(24px,5vw,64px). Tek kolon cam panel: data-erit, width:100%, max-width:1180px, padding:clamp(28px,3vw,44px), background:rgba(10,8,7,.74), border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.1), backdrop-filter:blur(3px). Ust baslik satiri: space-between, align-items:baseline, padding-bottom:22px, border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.14) -> sol 'Ocaktan' 700 clamp(32px,4vw,54px)/1.12 Bricolage, sag 'Beş ürün, iki ikram' 400 15px/1.5 rgba(242,233,220,.66). Ardindan 5 ozdes menu satiri (padding:22px 12px, border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.1), gap:18px 26px, cursor:pointer, transition:background .2s ease-out,padding-left .2s ease-out; hover background:rgba(250,170,31,.07) + padding-left:24px). Her satirin ic duzeni sabit: [sira no 600 13px tabular-nums rgba(242,233,220,.62) width:26px flex:none] [urun adi 700 clamp(22px,2.2vw,30px)/1.14 Bricolage letter-spacing:-.015em width:clamp(160px,20vw,260px) flex:none] [aciklama flex:1 min-width:200px 400 15px/1.5 rgba(242,233,220,.7)] [3'lu mini zar rayi 9/5/9px gap:4px rgba(242,233,220,.5) ve rgba(250,170,31,.8)] [fiyat 600 17px tabular-nums #FAAA1F width:96px text-align:right]. Fiyatlarin tumu '000 TL' yer tutucu.

section#ikram, min-height:100vh, align-items:center, justify-content:center, text-align:center, padding:120px clamp(24px,5vw,64px). Tek merkezli kolon: data-erit, max-width:900px, flex-column, align-items:center, gap:28px. Sira: (1) zar rayi 16/10/16/16/10/16px gap:10px (#F2E9DC ve #FAAA1F, dolu); (2) H2 700 clamp(38px,5.4vw,78px)/1.1 Bricolage letter-spacing:-.025em text-shadow:0 8px 50px rgba(10,8,7,.7); (3) paragraf 400 clamp(17px,1.5vw,21px)/1.6 rgba(242,233,220,.8) max-width:620px; (4) iki adet ikram cipi (flex-wrap, justify-content:center, gap:12px; her cip padding:13px 18px, border:1px solid rgba(250,170,31,.32), background:rgba(10,8,7,.55), align-items:baseline, gap:10px -> ad 700 17px/1.25 Bricolage letter-spacing:-.01em #F2E9DC + detay 400 13px/1.4 rgba(242,233,220,.66)); (5) genis foto plakasi width:min(760px,100%) height:clamp(120px,20vh,200px) margin-top:14px border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.2) box-shadow:inset 0 0 70px rgba(0,0,0,.45); sadece iki kose (sol-ust ve sag-alt, 20px, 16px icerlek, rgba(250,170,31,.55)); alt-ortada tasan etiket left:50%;bottom:-13px;translateX(-50%);padding:5px 12px;background:#0A0807.

section#gece, min-height:100vh, align-items:center, padding:120px clamp(24px,5vw,64px). data-erit sarmalayici max-width:1100px, flex-column, gap:30px, position:relative. Icinde: (0) data-saat-dev="1" dev hayalet saat position:absolute;z-index:-1;right:-2%;top:-16%; font:800 clamp(120px,22vw,320px)/1 Bricolage; tabular-nums; letter-spacing:-.04em; color:rgba(242,233,220,.055); pointer-events:none;user-select:none; (1) saat satiri flex-wrap gap:20px -> data-saat-tam 700 clamp(28px,3.4vw,44px) Bricolage #FAAA1F + width:clamp(30px,5vw,70px) 1px cizgi rgba(242,233,220,.34) + 'Ocak hala yanıyor' 400 16.5px rgba(242,233,220,.76); (2) H2 800 clamp(44px,7vw,112px)/1.08 Bricolage letter-spacing:-.03em text-shadow:0 10px 60px rgba(10,8,7,.7); (3) paragraf 400 clamp(17px,1.5vw,21px)/1.6 rgba(242,233,220,.8) max-width:640px; (4) margin-top:6px vardiya cipi seridi (flex-wrap gap:10px): alti cip data-vardiya=21|23|1|2|3|4 metinleri 21:00 / 23:00 / 01:00 / 02:00 / 03:00 / 04:00; pasif stil padding:9px 15px, border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.16), background:rgba(10,8,7,.5), font:500 13.5px/1 Inter, tabular-nums, color:rgba(242,233,220,.7), transition:all .3s ease-out; seridin sonunda padding-left:6px ile 26px cizgi + 'ocak 05:00'te söner' 400 13px rgba(242,233,220,.62).

bolumler.ad: Hikaye / Bozo (Bozo bir marka ismi değil)
bolumler.ozet: section#bozo (data-screen-label="Hikaye"), min-height:100vh, align-items:center, padding:120px clamp(24px,5vw,64px). data-erit sarmalayici flex-wrap gap:clamp(28px,3vw,56px) align-items:center. SOL cam panel (flex:1 1 460px, min-width:0, padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px), background:rgba(10,8,7,.72), border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.1), backdrop-filter:blur(3px), flex-column, gap:24px): (a) kicker satiri 11px amber kare + 500 14.5px rgba(242,233,220,.72) metin; (b) H2 700 clamp(32px,4vw,54px)/1.12 Bricolage letter-spacing:-.02em; (c) paragraf 400 clamp(16px,1.35vw,19px)/1.7 rgba(242,233,220,.78) max-width:560px; (d) <a href="Hikaye Sayfasi"> metin baglantisi: gap:10px, width:fit-content, transition:gap .18s ease-out, hover gap:18px; span 600 15px #FAAA1F + 24x1px #FAAA1F cizgi. SAG: iddia bolumundekiyle ayni olcu ve stildeki foto plakasi (flex:1 1 360px, min-width:280px, max-width:520px, height:clamp(360px,54vh,560px), border 1px rgba(242,233,220,.22), inset shadow 0 0 90px rgba(0,0,0,.5)), 4 kose L-isareti 24px/18px icerlek, sol-altta tasan etiket kutusu; iddia'daki merkez zar rayi burada YOK.

section#konum, min-height:100vh, align-items:center, padding:120px clamp(24px,5vw,64px). data-erit sarmalayici flex-wrap gap:clamp(28px,3vw,56px) align-items:stretch. SOL cam panel (flex:1 1 460px, min-width:0, padding:clamp(28px,3vw,44px), background:rgba(10,8,7,.74), border 1px rgba(242,233,220,.1), backdrop-filter:blur(3px), flex-column, gap:26px): (a) H2 700 clamp(30px,3.6vw,48px)/1.14 Bricolage; (b) margin-top:-12px pin ikonlu adres satiri (15x15 SVG pin, 400 15px/1.55); (c) saat tablosu flex-column: satir1 'Bugün' (data-bugun, JS gun adiyla degisir) + '10:00 - 05:00', padding:15px 12px, background:rgba(250,170,31,.07), border-bottom rgba(242,233,220,.12), 600 16px, deger #FAAA1F; satir2 'Pazartesi ile pazar' + '10:00 - 05:00', 400 16px rgba(242,233,220,.76), border-bottom rgba(242,233,220,.1); satir3 not metni padding:15px 12px 400 14.5px/1.6 rgba(242,233,220,.66); (d) 3'lu komsuluk cipi seridi (padding:9px 14px, border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.14), 500 13px, rgba(242,233,220,.7)); (e) margin-top:auto ile buton seridi: primary 'Yol tarifi al' (padding:18px 30px, box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(183,53,28,.34)), outline telefon '000 000 00 00' (padding:17px 29px, tabular-nums), outline 'WhatsApp'. SAG: harita plakasi (flex:1 1 380px, min-width:280px, max-width:560px, min-height:420px, border 1px rgba(242,233,220,.16), background:rgba(10,8,7,.55)) icinde 50px'lik izgara deseni rgba(242,233,220,.05), top:56% 14px yatay yol seridi rgba(242,233,220,.08), left:44% 9px dikey yol rgba(242,233,220,.06), left:46%/top:53% 80px halka border rgba(183,53,28,.5) + 16px nabizli isaret #B7351C (box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(183,53,28,.22),0 0 30px rgba(183,53,28,.85), dotPulse 2.6s), isaret altinda 'Ciğerci Bozo' etiketi, left:8%/top:59% 'Naci Talat Caddesi' sokak etiketi, sol-altta 'harita · koyu tema, tek işaret' notu.

<section> DEGIL: id'siz, data-yogunluk'suz bir <div data-screen-label="Paket">. Sayfanin tek acik zeminli blogu: background:#E96112, padding:clamp(40px,6vh,64px) clamp(24px,5vw,64px), flex-wrap, align-items:center, justify-content:space-between, gap:24px 40px. SOL (flex-column, gap:12px, max-width:620px): koyu zar rayi 12/7/12/12/7/12px gap:8px (#1A1614 ve rgba(26,22,20,.55)); baslik 700 clamp(28px,3vw,40px)/1.16 Bricolage letter-spacing:-.02em color:#1A1614; paragraf 400 clamp(15px,1.3vw,17px)/1.6 rgba(26,22,20,.9). SAG buton seridi (flex-wrap, gap:12px): koyu dolu buton 'Paket sipariş' (background:#1A1614, padding:18px 30px, 600 16px, color:#F2E9DC, transition:transform .15s ease-out,box-shadow .15s ease-out; hover translateY(-2px) + box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(26,22,20,.4)); WhatsApp butonu (15x15 SVG + metin, border:1px solid rgba(26,22,20,.55), padding:17px 26px, hover background:rgba(26,22,20,.1)); telefon butonu '000 000 00 00' (ayni outline stil, padding:17px 29px, tabular-nums). Bu blok data-erit tasimaz, kaydirma parlaklik animasyonuna girmez.

<div data-screen-label="Footer">, id'siz, data-yogunluk'suz, data-erit'siz. padding:64px clamp(24px,5vw,64px) 32px, background:rgba(10,8,7,.9), border-top:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.1). Ust satir flex-wrap, justify-content:space-between, gap:38px 56px, dort kolon: (1) Marka (max-width:280px, gap:14px): zar rayi 9/5/9/9/5/9px gap:6px rgba(242,233,220,.75)+#FAAA1F, 'Ciğerci Bozo' 800 20px Bricolage letter-spacing:-.03em, tanim 400 14.5px/1.65 rgba(242,233,220,.66); (2) Adres (gap:13px): baslik 600 14.5px #F2E9DC, pin SVG + uc satirlik adres 400 14.5px/1.7, altinda data-git="konum" 'Yol tarifi al' oklu link (600 14px #FAAA1F + 22x1px cizgi, transition:gap .18s ease-out, hover gap:16px); (3) Saatler: baslik + uc satir 400 14.5px rgba(242,233,220,.7) (ilk ikisi tabular-nums); (4) İletişim: baslik + telefon/WhatsApp/Instagram satirlari, her biri 15x15 SVG + metin, cursor:pointer, transition:color .15s ease-out, hover color:#FAAA1F. Alt serit: margin-top:46px, padding-top:20px, border-top:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.09), space-between -> telif 400 12.5px rgba(242,233,220,.5) ve opacity:.45 mini zar rayi 7/4/7/7/4/7px gap:4px.

paylasilanBilesenler.gorev: Sayfa boyunca yinelenen aksiyon butonu. Hepsi <div>/<a>, gercek <button> yok; React'te <button>/<Link> olarak yeniden yazilmali.
varyantlar: primary-sm (ust bar): background:#B7351C; padding:13px 24px; font:600 14.5px/1 Inter; color:#F2E9DC; box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(183,53,28,.36); hover background:#C93E22, box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(183,53,28,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(250,170,31,.6), transform:translateY(-1px)
primary-lg (hero): padding:20px 34px; font:600 16.5px/1; box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(183,53,28,.4); hover box-shadow:0 16px 46px rgba(183,53,28,.6),0 0 0 1px rgba(250,170,31,.6), translateY(-1px)
primary-md (konum): padding:18px 30px; font:600 16px/1; box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(183,53,28,.34); hover background:#C93E22, translateY(-1px) (kenarlik glow yok)

outline-lg (hero 'Menüyü gör'): border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.4); padding:19px 33px; font:600 16.5px/1; background:rgba(10,8,7,.4); hover border-color:rgba(250,170,31,.85), background:rgba(250,170,31,.12)
outline-md (konum telefon/WhatsApp): border:1px solid rgba(242,233,220,.36); padding:17px 29px; font:600 16px/1; hover border-color:rgba(250,170,31,.85), background:rgba(250,170,31,.1)
koyu-dolu (paket bandi): background:#1A1614; padding:18px 30px; font:600 16px/1; color:#F2E9DC; hover translateY(-2px) + box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(26,22,20,.4)
koyu-outline (paket bandi): border:1px solid rgba(26,22,20,.55); padding:17px 26px (ikonlu) veya 17px 29px (ikonsuz); color:#1A1614; hover background:rgba(26,22,20,.1)
paylasilanBilesenler.kesinDegerler: Dolgu rengi #B7351C, hover #C93E22; metin #F2E9DC; kose yarıcapi YOK (0, keskin); transition:background .15s ease-out, box-shadow .15s ease-out, transform .15s ease-out; telefon butonlarinda font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums

paylasilanBilesenler.gorev: Marka imzasi: buyuk-kucuk-buyuk-buyuk-kucuk-buyuk dizilimli 6 kare. Buyuk kareler border-radius:2px (kucuk boyutlarda 1px), kucuk kareler radius:1px ve amber. Tek bir bilesen + size/tone prop'u ile karsilanmali.
varyantlar: ustBarLogo: 8/5/8/8/5/8px, gap:4px, #F2E9DC + #FAAA1F
hero: 20/12/20/20/12/20px, gap:12px, #F2E9DC + #FAAA1F, arkada 3px yatay cizgi linear-gradient(to right,#F2E9DC 54%,rgba(242,233,220,.1)), margin-top:-1.5px
ikram: 16/10/16/16/10/16px, gap:10px, #F2E9DC + #FAAA1F
iddiaPlakaAnahat: 22/13/22/22/13/22px, gap:11px, dolgu yok, border 1px rgba(242,233,220,.5) ve rgba(250,170,31,.6), kapsayici opacity:.5
ocaktanSatiri: yalnizca 3 kare 9/5/9px, gap:4px, rgba(242,233,220,.5) + rgba(250,170,31,.8)
footerMarka: 9/5/9/9/5/9px, gap:6px, rgba(242,233,220,.75) + #FAAA1F
footerAlt: 7/4/7/7/4/7px, gap:4px, #F2E9DC + #FAAA1F, kapsayici opacity:.45
paylasilanBilesenler.kesinDegerler: Kucuk (amber) kareler border-radius almaz veya 1px alir; buyuk kareler 8px+ boyutta border-radius:2px, 9px altinda 1px. Amber #FAAA1F, krem #F2E9DC, koyu varyant #1A1614.

varyantlar: buyuk bead (acilis, ocaktan, ikram, bozo, konum): 14x14px, border-radius:2px
kucuk bead (iddia, gece): 9x9px, border-radius:1px
aktif durum (JS): background:#B7351C, transform:scale(1.5), box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(183,53,28,.9)
pasif durum: background:rgba(242,233,220,.26), transform:none, box-shadow:none

davranislar.ad: saatiYaz — canli saat ve acik/kapali durumu
davranislar.detay: Saat kaynagi: new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Europe/Nicosia'})); isNaN ise new Date()'e duser, try/catch ile de new Date()'e duser. h=getHours(), m=getMinutes(), p(n)=String(n).padStart(2,'0'). Yazdigi hedefler: [data-saat-s]=p(h), [data-saat-d]=p(m), [data-saat-tam]=p(h)+':'+p(m), [data-saat-dev]=p(h)+':'+p(m). acik = (h >= 10 || h < 5). [data-durum] metni TR acik 'Şu an açığız' / TR kapali "Şu an kapalıyız, 10:00'da açılıyoruz", EN 'We are open' / 'We are closed, opening at 10:00'; rengi acik #FAAA1F, kapali rgba(242,233,220,.8). [data-durum-alt] TR acik "Ocak 05:00'e kadar yanıyor" / kapali 'Kapalı aralık: 05:00 - 10:00', EN 'The fire is lit until 05:00' / 'Closed only between 05:00 and 10:00'. [data-nokta] acik background:#FAAA1F + box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(250,170,31,.9), kapali background:rgba(242,233,220,.35) + box-shadow:none. React'te SSR/hydration uyusmazligini onlemek icin ilk render'da bos/deger-yoksun basilip useEffect ile doldurulmali.
[data-gece-serit].style.display = (h >= 1 && h < 5) ? 'flex' : 'none'. Yani serit yalnizca 01:00 ile 04:59 arasinda gorunur; HTML'deki baslangic degeri display:none.

vardiyalar = [21,23,1,2,3,4]. Her v icin fark = ((h - v) + 24) % 24; kosul: fark <= 1 VE (yakin === null || fark < ((h - yakin) + 24) % 24) ise yakin = v. Sonra tum [data-vardiya] icin aktif = parseInt(attr,10) === yakin. Aktif stil: borderColor 'rgba(250,170,31,.85)', color '#FAAA1F', background 'rgba(250,170,31,.12)'. Pasif stil: borderColor 'rgba(242,233,220,.16)', color 'rgba(242,233,220,.66)', background 'rgba(10,8,7,.5)'. Hicbiri eslesmezse (ornegin h=12) tum cipler pasif kalir.

gunler = ['Pazar','Pazartesi','Salı','Çarşamba','Perşembe','Cuma','Cumartesi']. [data-bugun].textContent = this.en ? 'Today' : gunler[h < 5 ? (g.getDay() + 6) % 7 : g.getDay()]. Yani 05:00 oncesi hala bir onceki gunun adini gosterir (gece vardiyasi mantigi). HTML'deki baslangic metni 'Bugün' ilk tick'te gun adiyla degisir.

davranislar.tetikleyici: window scroll (passive) + mount aninda bir kez
davranislar.detay: max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight; [data-ilerleme].style.width = (max > 0 ? (window.pageYOffset / max) * 100 : 0) + '%'. CSS'te transition:width .12s linear. Ayri bir scroll dinleyicisi, rAF throttle YOK.

davranislar.tetikleyici: window scroll (passive) + mount aninda bir kez + her kaydir() cagrisinda
davranislar.detay: [data-sahne-kap].style.transform = 'translate3d(0,' + window.pageYOffset + 'px,0)'. absolute konumlu 100vh sahneyi viewport'a sabitler (position:fixed yerine transform ile), boylece will-change:transform ile GPU katmaninda kalir.

davranislar.tetikleyici: scroll ve resize -> kaydir() -> requestAnimationFrame(cerceve); ayrica mount sonunda bir kez dogrudan cerceve()
davranislar.detay: prefers-reduced-motion aktifse tumuyle atlanir. ekran = window.innerHeight. Her [data-erit] icin r = getBoundingClientRect(); r.bottom <= 0 || r.top >= ekran ise opacity='1', transform='none' ve cikilir. Aksi halde gorunen = Math.min(r.bottom, ekran) - Math.max(r.top, 0); o = clamp(gorunen / Math.min(r.height, ekran * 0.62), 0, 1); opacity = 0.86 + o * 0.14; transform = 'translate3d(0,' + ((1 - o) * 14) + 'px,0)'. Elemanlara mount'ta transition:'opacity .5s ease-out, transform .5s ease-out' atanir.

davranislar.ad: cerceve — aktif bolum, yogunluk ve ates yogunlugu
davranislar.tetikleyici: Ayni cerceve() cagrisi (scroll/resize, rAF ile throttle)
davranislar.detay: orta = window.innerHeight / 2. Tum [data-bolum] icin d = Math.abs((r.top + r.height / 2) - orta); en kucuk d kazanir -> aktifAd = data-bolum, yogunluk = parseFloat(data-yogunluk || '1'). Ardindan: kor.style.opacity = Math.min(1, 0.3 + yogunluk * 0.7); kor.style.transform = 'scale(' + (0.9 + yogunluk * 0.16) + ')'; cekirdek.style.opacity = Math.min(1, 0.24 + yogunluk * 0.6). Elemanlarin kendi CSS gecisleri: kor transition:opacity .9s ease-out, transform .9s ease-out; cekirdek transition:opacity .9s ease-out. Yogunluk degerleri: acilis 1, iddia 0.55, ocaktan 0.4, ikram 0.7, gece 1.25, bozo 0.45, konum 0.3 (gece'de 1.25 -> kor opacity min(1, 1.175)=1, scale 1.1).

Her [data-bead] icin aktif = getAttribute('data-bead') === aktifAd. Aktif: background '#B7351C', transform 'scale(1.5)', boxShadow '0 0 16px rgba(183,53,28,.9)'. Pasif: background 'rgba(242,233,220,.26)', transform 'none', boxShadow 'none'. CSS transition:all .3s ease-out.

kaydir(): once sahneyiKilitle() cagrilir (throttle disi), sonra this.bekliyor true ise cikilir; degilse this.bekliyor = true ve requestAnimationFrame(cerceve). cerceve() sonunda this.bekliyor = false. React'te useRef ile tutulmali.

davranislar.tetikleyici: [data-sayac] elemani viewport'ta %50 gorunur oldugunda, yalnizca bir kez
davranislar.detay: new IntersectionObserver(..., { threshold: 0.5 }). isIntersecting olunca hemen unobserve edilir. hedef = parseInt(data-sayac,10); !hedef veya prefers-reduced-motion ise animasyon calismaz (metin HTML'deki degerde kalir). t0 = performance.now(); her karede o = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 900); textContent = String(Math.round(hedef * (1 - Math.pow(1 - o, 3)))) — 900ms easeOutCubic. Sayfada iki hedef var: 8 ve 3. '4+2' hucresinde data-sayac yoktur, animasyona girmez.

hedef = document.getElementById(el.getAttribute('data-git')); yoksa hicbir sey yapilmaz. window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, hedef.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 70), behavior: azalt ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }) — 70px sabit ust bar ofseti. Sayfadaki data-git hedefleri: acilis (logo, bead), gece (nav + bead), iddia (hero scroll ipucu + bead), ocaktan (hero 'Menüyü gör' + bead), ikram (bead), bozo (bead), konum (bead + footer 'Yol tarifi al'). Ayrica CSS'te html{scroll-behavior:smooth}.

[data-imlec].style.transform = 'translate3d(' + ((e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2) * 0.34) + 'px,' + ((e.clientY - window.innerHeight * 0.62) * 0.34) + 'px,0)'. Eleman CSS'i transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); will-change:transform. Carpan 0.34, dikey merkez innerHeight*0.62.

this.en = en. Tum [data-en] elemanlari icin: data-tr yoksa once el.setAttribute('data-tr', el.textContent) ile mevcut TR metni saklanir, sonra el.textContent = en ? data-en : data-tr. TR butonu color = en ? 'rgba(242,233,220,.58)' : '#F2E9DC'; EN butonu color = en ? '#F2E9DC' : 'rgba(242,233,220,.58)'. Sonunda this.saatiYaz() yeniden cagrilir (durum, durumAlt ve gun adi dile gore yeniden yazilsin diye). DIKKAT: data-en yalnizca metni ceviri gerektiren dugumlerde var; H1 'Tavla zarı ciğer', 'meşe korunda', urun adlari (Ciğer, Dalak, Yürek, Kuzu şiş, Terbiyesiz tavuk şiş), cip adlari (Lebeni çorbası, Bostana), foto plaka etiketleri, harita etiketleri, 'Ciğerci Bozo', 'Her gün 10:00 - 05:00', saat degerleri ve '000 TL'/'000 000 00 00' yer tutuculari data-en TASIMAZ ve ceviride degismez. React'te bu ayrim aynen korunmali (ceviri sozlugu bu dugumleri kapsamamali ya da TR/EN degeri ozdes olmali).

azalt=true iken: erit opacity/transform hesabi tamamen atlanir ve transition atanmaz; sayac animasyonu calismaz; imlec mousemove dinleyicisi baglanmaz; data-git kaydirmasi behavior:'auto' olur. Ates/duman/nabiz animasyonlari ise CSS medya sorgusu ile kapatilir: @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none !important;transition:none !important} html{scroll-behavior:auto}}. Saat, ilerleme cubugu, sahne kilidi, bead aktifligi ve dil degistirme azalt durumunda da calisir.

clearInterval(this.saatTimer); this.bolumGozlemci?.disconnect(); this.sayacGozlemci?.disconnect(). NOT: this.bolumGozlemci hicbir yerde olusturulmuyor (olu referans). scroll/resize/mousemove dinleyicileri kaldirilmiyor — React portuna tasinirken useEffect cleanup'inda removeEventListener eklenmeli.

if (this.kuruldu) return; ardindan [data-bolum="acilis"] DOM'da yoksa yine cikilir (this.kuruldu set edilmez, bir sonraki update'te tekrar denenir). Bulununca this.kuruldu = true. React'te useEffect + bos bagimlilik dizisi ile karsilanir.
